solverDefinition: A pseudo-polynomial time solver for the 0-1 Knapsack decision problem using bottom-up dynamic programming. Builds an (N+1) x (W+1) table where dp[i,w] is the maximum value achievable using the first i items within capacity w, then backtracks through the table to recover the chosen subset. Runs in O(N*W) time and space.
source: Bellman, Richard. Dynamic Programming. Princeton University Press, 1957.
